title: Colombian Scientists Develop Substance to Protect Bees from Chemicals (2/2)
titleZh: 哥倫比亞科學家研發新物質，保護蜜蜂免受化學藥劑傷害 (2/2)
summaryZh: 哥倫比亞學者研究能改善蜜蜂健康、防止農藥造成神經損傷的分子。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Science & Technology

sentences.text: In a bee colony at the university, said Juan Jose Ovalier.
sentences.zh: 就在大學裡的一個蜂群中，Juan Jose Ovalier 說。

sentences.text: He is a natural science student at Rosario University.
sentences.zh: 他是羅薩里奧大學自然科學系的學生。

sentences.text: We already know that there are molecules that improve the bees' health.
sentences.zh: 我們已經知道，有些分子可以改善蜜蜂的健康。

sentences.text: We already know that there are molecules that prevent neuronal damage caused by pesticides, Ovalier said.
sentences.zh: 我們也已經知道，有些分子能防止農藥造成的神經損傷，Ovalier 說。

sentences.text: He added, It was important to continue the work to increase the effectiveness of these methods to support bees.
sentences.zh: 他還說，繼續研究、提高這些方法的成效來幫助蜜蜂，是很重要的事。
